classification.difficultyReason: Combine equal distances from the centre with perpendicular bisection of a chord.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two chords meet at the bottom of a circle. Matching ticks on dashed perpendiculars from the centre establish equal distances to the chords. The unknown x is the left chord's endpoint-to-foot distance; the complete right chord is 14 cm.
spec.mathematics: Equal perpendicular distances from the centre imply equal chords. Each perpendicular bisects its chord, so x is half of 14 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x and the given 14 cm are visible; the supplied 7 cm answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The chords are equidistant from the centre, so they are equal in length. The perpendicular from the centre bisects the left chord.
$$\begin{aligned}2x&=14\\x&=7\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
